summary: Gate 3 passes with no blocking findings. The checkout at f5b3a2609 contains only evidence: the note (psana/psana/gpu/notes/pr299_perlmutter_20261115.md), frozen harness/analysis scripts plus the packaging verifier and its tests, the 630-file evidence directory, SOURCE_SHA256SUMS, archive-map.json, SHA256SUMS, and the packaging-validation.json receipt. The receipt is internally consistent with what I read: preparation_commit and the recorded git rev-parse both say 5183e2d07, it reports 630 package files, 624 byte-preserved copies, 1171 rehashed source entries, the 5-test unittest run OK (including the five tamper subcases coded in test_verify_archive.py), bash -n on both shell wrappers, and a scoped git diff --check that excludes exactly the three documented source-format exceptions. SHA256SUMS at this commit lists 630 entries and includes packaging-validation.json (line 580), consistent with the reported post-receipt verifier pass on 631 files. The note's numbers match campaign-summary.json and plots/paired-timings.csv (I recomputed the GPU BD1 paired MPI-wall change: min -10.47%, max +4.81%, median -1.73%). review-approval-campaign.json, reviews/campaign-r1.json, and status.json agree on manifest 1433a210..., pilot digest b08dd643..., reviewed_commit acfd029a8, verdict pass, 24 pairs, complete=true. C1 is stated as blocking and unfixed, Run77 deferred, acceptance explicitly not equivalence, and raw storage/event/build omissions are explicit in the note, FINAL_REPORT, README and receipt. No performance job or production change is present. The bounded records-only follow-up commit and single non-forced push to features/psana2-gpu-steps are acceptable as planned, with the nonblocking conditions below; the two carried documentation advisories should be closed in that commit and the push must stop if the remote tip is no longer acfd029a8.
checks: Read the results note, FINAL_REPORT.txt, scripts README, verify_archive.py, test_verify_archive.py, packaging-validation.json (all sections except the long git diff --name-only stdout line), review-approval-campaign.json, reviews/campaign-r1.json, status.json, campaign-summary.json, plots/paired-timings.csv, and SHA256SUMS (head plus targeted entries).

Receipt consistency: preparation_commit 5183e2d07 equals recorded git rev-parse HEAD; archive_result matches verify() return shape and the note's counts (630 files, 624 copies, 1171 source entries, 12 preflights, 48 samples, 24 pairs, measured head acfd029a8, manifest 1433a210...).

SHA256SUMS at f5b3a2609 has 630 entries and includes packaging-validation.json, the note, scripts README, verifier and tests; verifier's coverage rule (all files under scripts and evidence plus the note, minus SHA256SUMS itself) implies 631 package files, matching the supplied post-receipt result.
Negative integrity tests exist in code: modified, missing, extra, symlink, mapped_hash subcases with distinct expected error messages; receipt stderr shows 5 tests OK.

Note table versus campaign-summary.json: all six paired medians, ranges, loop medians, order-gap figures (GPU BD1 +2.52/-2.79, 5.31 pp) and MPI-wall medians agree; recomputed GPU BD1 paired MPI-wall change from CSV (-3.68, -10.47, +4.81, +0.22; median -1.73) matches the note.

Approval binding: review-approval-campaign.json, reviews/campaign-r1.json and status.json share manifest 1433a210... and pilot digest b08dd643...; historical review verdict pass, reviewed_commit acfd029a8, no blocking findings; deferred F-END-TIME and F-CAMPAIGN-LOOP-TEST are disclosed in the note.

Scope statements: C1 blocking/unfixed, Run77 deferred, not equivalence, not merge approval, raw storage/event arrays/build trees omitted, CPU controls not equal-byte, all present in note, FINAL_REPORT, campaign-summary.json and README.

Source-format exceptions: three files excluded from git diff --check in the receipt match README and receipt lists; hook exceptions limited to trailing-whitespace and end-of-file-fixer, which exist in .pre-commit-config.yaml; other hooks (including mixed-line-ending, check-added-large-files) remain enabled.

Secrets: receipt records a targeted pattern scan with no matches; the only absolute paths seen are scratch/conda paths, not credentials. Account balances and reviewer invocation records are stated as excluded.

Bytecode risk: .gitignore ignores *.pyc but verifier rglob covers untracked working-tree files, so stray __pycache__ would fail coverage; no __pycache__ exists in the checkout; README documents python -B commands.
No tests, hashes, or git commands were executed by me; test and hash results are taken from the receipt and coordinator-supplied validation.
limitations: Read-only review; I ran no verifier, tests, hashing or git commands. Remote branch state, PR metadata, clean detached worktree, and merge-base result are coordinator/helper-supplied evidence.

packaging-validation.json line 103 (git diff --name-only stdout) was omitted by the tool as an overlong line; the payload_hashes block (lines 152-782) was read only at its tail. archive-map.json was read only for its first ~790 lines; campaign-validation.json, manifest.json and campaign-storage files were read only by targeted grep.
I did not independently compute any SHA-256 value; the match between SHA256SUMS, archive-map.json and SOURCE_SHA256SUMS is taken from the receipt and the verifier's logic.
This gate judges evidence-package readiness and the bounded records-only exception only. It is not a C1 merge-readiness judgment or a statistical re-analysis.

findings.evidence: The Evidence and scripts list links SOURCE_SHA256SUMS, archive-map.json and SHA256SUMS but neither this note nor scripts/pr299_perlmutter/README.md mentions packaging-validation.json or the reviews/ directory, although SHA256SUMS line 580 covers the receipt.
findings.requested_change: In the records-only commit, add a link to evidence/pr299_perlmutter_20261115/packaging-validation.json and to reviews/, stating the receipt describes the 630-file pre-receipt payload at 5183e2d07. Links must be relative to the note's directory because verify_archive.py checks every Markdown link target exists.

findings.evidence: package_files() rglobs the working tree, so any untracked __pycache__ under scripts/ or evidence/ triggers 'Checksum coverage differs'. .gitignore line 14 ignores *.pyc for git only. README lines 72-73 give python3 -B commands but do not explain why.
findings.requested_change: Documentation only: in the README verification section, state that stray bytecode causes a checksum-coverage failure and that -B is required (or delete __pycache__ before verifying). No verifier change.

findings.evidence: Tamper subcases cover checksum, coverage, symlink and mapped-hash layers; semantic contracts (pair order, medians, sustained windows, storage aggregation) have positive full-archive coverage only. Explicitly deferred by agreed scope.
findings.requested_change: None for this gate. Carry as deferred hardening; do not alter verifier or tests in the records-only commit.

findings.evidence: verify() requires SHA256SUMS to cover exactly all files under scripts/ and evidence/ plus the note. Adding review records under reviews/ and editing the note or README therefore changes required coverage and hashes, while archive-map.json entries (624 byte-preserved files) must remain unchanged.
findings.requested_change: In the records-only commit: regenerate SHA256SUMS, do not edit packaging-validation.json or any archive-map.json-listed file, rerun verify_archive.py and the unittest with -B, rerun the scoped git diff --check, and record those outputs in the review records. Confirm archive-map.json and SOURCE_SHA256SUMS hashes are unchanged.

findings.evidence: The pushed tip will be a documentation commit on top of f5b3a2609, so the public branch head will not equal the exact SHA reviewed here. The note already states the archive commit is not the measured head.
findings.requested_change: State in the records-only commit message and README note that f5b3a2609 is the independently reviewed payload and the final commit adds records only. Before pushing, re-read refs/heads/features/psana2-gpu-steps and stop if it is not acfd029a8d27898b5f165e02facd3c3bbc9c4ad2; push once, non-forced, then confirm remote SHA and PR head. No PR comment or merge.
